name: The majority voted in favour of a motion introduced by ACT Senator [Katy Gallagher](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/katy_gallagher) (Labor), which means it was successful. This means the vote on whether to pass the [Migration Amendment (Bridging Visa Conditions) Bill 2023](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7114) can be had immediately. ### Motion text > *That the order agreed to earlier today, relating to the consideration of the Migration Amendment (Bridging Visa Conditions) Bill 2023, be amended to provide that the questions on all remaining stages of the bill be put immediately, including any circulated amendments.*
